summary_zh: 本页为绘本《小红帽》的封面，展示了书名、作者、出版社信息以及戴着红色斗篷的小女孩在草地上奔跑，旁边有一只小白兔和蝴蝶的插图。

page_text_ocr_zh: 从前，有一个活泼可爱的小姑娘，谁见了她都喜欢。不过，最疼爱她的是奶奶，她要什么奶奶就给她什么，甚至恨不得把天上的星星也摘下来送给她。奶奶送给小姑娘一顶带帽子的红色斗篷。小姑娘特别喜欢它，天天都戴着，于是，大家都叫她“小红帽”。
page_text_en: Once upon a time, there was a lively and lovely little girl whom everyone liked. But the one who loved her most was her grandmother. Whatever she wanted, her grandmother would give it to her, even wishing she could pick the stars from the sky and give them to her. The grandmother gave the little girl a red cloak with a hood. The girl loved it very much and wore it every day, so everyone called her 'Little Red Riding Hood'.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了小红帽的来历：一个活泼可爱的小女孩深受奶奶疼爱，奶奶送她一顶红色带帽斗篷，她天天戴着，因此大家叫她‘小红帽’。画面左侧是奶奶为她缝制斗篷，右侧是奶奶亲吻她。

page_text_ocr_zh:
有一天，妈妈对小红帽说：“奶奶生病了，小红帽你给奶奶送点儿蛋糕和水果去吧。奶奶见到你会很高兴，病也会好得快一点儿。”
小红帽拿起东西就往外走。妈妈拉住她，不放心地叮嘱道：“不要跑得太快，小红帽，不然会摔倒，记住啊，也不要在森林里贪玩，否则会耽误时间。”
“我知道啦，妈妈。”小红帽说完，就跑出了家门。
page_text_en:
One day, Mom said to Little Red Riding Hood, "Grandma is sick. Little Red Riding Hood, take some cake and fruit to Grandma. Grandma will be very happy to see you, and her illness will get better faster." 
Little Red Riding Hood picked up the things and started to go out. Mom held her back, worriedly reminding, "Don't run too fast, Little Red Riding Hood, or you might fall. Remember, don't play around in the forest, or you'll waste time." 
"I know, Mom," Little Red Riding Hood said, and then ran out of the door.
summary_zh: 妈妈让小红帽给生病的奶奶送蛋糕和水果，并叮嘱她不要跑太快、不要在森林里贪玩。小红帽答应后跑出了家门。画面右侧是妈妈拉住小红帽的手，左侧是装有食物的篮子。

page_text_ocr_zh: 奶奶的家在森林里，离小红帽的家有很长一段路。小红帽刚走进森林，就遇到了一只狼。狼问她：“小姑娘，你叫什么名字，要到哪儿去啊？”“我叫小红帽，要到奶奶家去。奶奶病了，我给她送蛋糕和水果。”小红帽很有礼貌地回答，她不知道狼是个坏家伙。狼开始打坏主意了，“小红帽，你奶奶住在哪儿啊？”小红帽老老实实地回答：“就在大路尽头的橡树底下。”
page_text_en: Grandma's house is in the forest, a long way from Little Red Riding Hood's home. As Little Red Riding Hood just entered the forest, she met a wolf. The wolf asked her, "Little girl, what's your name, and where are you going?" "I'm Little Red Riding Hood, going to Grandma's house. Grandma is sick, and I'm bringing her cake and fruit," Little Red Riding Hood answered politely, not knowing the wolf was a bad creature. The wolf began to hatch a bad plan, "Little Red Riding Hood, where does your grandma live?" Little Red Riding Hood answered honestly, "Right at the end of the path, under the oak tree."
summary_zh: 小红帽在前往奶奶家的路上遇到一只狼，狼询问她的名字和去向，小红帽礼貌地回答并告知奶奶家的位置，却不知狼心怀不轨。

page_text_ocr_zh:
狼心中暗暗盘算：这小东西细皮嫩肉的，一定很好吃。她奶奶病了，应该也很好对付，我要想个办法，把她们都吃掉！
于是，狼假装和蔼地对小红帽说：“小红帽，这些花多美啊，你为什么不好好看一看呢？小鸟的歌声多好听啊，你干吗不停下来听一听呢？还有，森林里有那么多好玩儿的东西，你却只顾埋头往前走，就像去上学一样，真是没劲透了！”
page_text_en:
The wolf thought to himself: This little thing is tender and delicate, must be delicious. Her grandmother is sick, she should be easy to deal with too. I need to think of a way to eat them both!
Then, the wolf pretended to be kind and said to Little Red Riding Hood: "Little Red Riding Hood, these flowers are so beautiful. Why don't you stop and take a good look? The birds' songs are so lovely. Why don't you stop and listen? And there are so many fun things in the forest. Yet you just keep your head down and walk forward, like you're going to school. How boring!"
summary_zh: 狼在心里盘算如何吃掉小红帽和她的奶奶，并假装和蔼地劝说小红帽在森林里多停留、欣赏风景，试图引诱她偏离路线。

page_text_ocr_zh:
听了狼的话，小红帽心动了。她还是个小姑娘呢，怎么会不贪玩呢？
小红帽心想：“他说得有道理。我应该在森林里玩一会儿，再摘一束鲜花送给奶奶，让她高兴高兴。现在还早，玩一会儿怕什么呢？”
于是她又蹦又跳地离开了大路，来到了森林深处。她一会儿采花，一会儿扑蝴蝶，又一会儿追野兔，玩得可高兴了。
page_text_en:
Hearing the wolf's words, Little Red Riding Hood was tempted. After all, she was still a little girl—how could she not want to play?
Little Red Riding Hood thought, 'He's right. I should play in the forest for a while, then pick a bouquet of flowers to give Grandma and make her happy. It's still early—what's the harm in playing for a bit?'
So she skipped and jumped off the path, heading deep into the forest. She picked flowers for a while, chased butterflies, then ran after a wild rabbit—she was having a wonderful time.
summary_zh: 小红帽被狼的话打动，决定在森林里玩耍，她采花、追蝴蝶、追野兔，玩得非常开心，不知不觉偏离了去奶奶家的路。

page_text_ocr_zh: 狼呢？他飞快地跑到了小红帽奶奶家，敲了敲门。“是谁啊？”“是我，奶奶，我是小红帽啊。”狼尖着嗓子说，“奶奶，我给您送蛋糕和水果来了。”“哦，是小红帽啊，门没锁，你自己开门进来吧。我没有力气，起不来。”狼打开门，冲到奶奶床前。奶奶见了狼，吓得浑身直哆嗦。狼张开大嘴，一口就把奶奶吞进了肚子，然后穿上了奶奶的衣服，戴上了奶奶的帽子，躺在床上等着小红帽。
page_text_en: Where is the wolf? He ran quickly to Grandma's house and knocked on the door. "Who is it?" "It's me, Grandma, it's Little Red Riding Hood." The wolf said in a high-pitched voice, "Grandma, I've come to bring you cake and fruit." "Oh, it's Little Red Riding Hood, the door isn't locked, come in yourself. I don't have the strength to get up." The wolf opened the door and rushed to Grandma's bedside. Grandma saw the wolf and trembled with fear. The wolf opened his big mouth and swallowed Grandma whole. Then he put on Grandma's clothes, wore Grandma's hat, and lay in bed waiting for Little Red Riding Hood.
summary_zh: 狼迅速赶到奶奶家，假扮小红帽骗奶奶开门，随后吃掉奶奶，并穿上她的衣服和帽子躺在床上等待小红帽到来。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小红帽在森林里玩得开心极了。她采了许多花，多得都快拿不下啦，这才心满意足地往奶奶家走去。
小红帽看见奶奶家的大门敞开着，觉得很奇怪，但是，她还是走了进去。她一进屋就大声喊：“奶奶，奶奶，我来看你啦！”可是奶奶没有回答她。
“啊！亲爱的奶奶她一定是病得很厉害，不想大声讲话吧。”小红帽这么想着，赶紧走到了奶奶床前。
page_text_en:
Little Red Riding Hood had a wonderful time in the forest. She picked many flowers, so many that she could hardly carry them all, and then happily walked toward Grandma's house.
Little Red Riding Hood saw that Grandma's door was wide open. She felt strange, but still walked in. As soon as she entered, she shouted loudly, "Grandma, Grandma, I'm here to see you!" But Grandma didn't answer her.
"Ah! Dear Grandma must be very sick and doesn't want to speak loudly," Little Red Riding Hood thought, and quickly walked to Grandma's bedside.
summary_zh: 小红帽在森林里采花玩耍后，来到奶奶家，发现门开着，奶奶没有回应，她以为奶奶病重，便走到床前。

page_text_ocr_zh:
奶奶躺在床上，帽子拉得低低的，看起来非常奇怪。
“奶奶啊，您的耳朵为什么这么大呀？”“为了更好地听你说话啊！”“奶奶，您的眼睛为什么这么大呀？”“为了更清楚地看到你啊！”“奶奶，您的嘴巴怎么大得吓人呀？”“这样才能一口把你吃掉啊！”狼一说完，就从床上跳起来，把小红帽吞进了肚子。
page_text_en:
Grandma was lying in bed, her hat pulled low, looking very strange.
"Grandma, why are your ears so big?" "So I can hear you better!" "Grandma, why are your eyes so big?" "So I can see you more clearly!" "Grandma, why is your mouth so big and scary?" "So I can eat you up in one bite!" As soon as the wolf finished speaking, it jumped up from the bed and swallowed Little Red Riding Hood whole.
summary_zh: 小红帽来到奶奶家，发现奶奶异常，询问后被狼揭露真面目，狼随即跳起将她吞下。

page_text_ocr_zh:
狼吃饱了，他心满意足地躺在床上，不一会儿就睡着了，呼噜打得震天响。
奶奶的好朋友猎人碰巧从房子前路过，他被打雷一样的呼噜声吓了一跳。猎人心想：“真奇怪，老奶奶以前可不这么打呼噜，我得进去看看是不是出了什么事。”
猎人走到床前，发现躺在床上的竟然是一只狼。他端起猎枪准备开枪，但转念一想：“狼可能把老奶奶吞进肚子里了，老奶奶或许还活着呢。”
page_text_en:
The wolf was full. He lay on the bed, content, and soon fell asleep, snoring loudly like thunder.
Grandma's good friend, the hunter, happened to pass by the house. He was startled by the thunderous snoring. The hunter thought, "Strange, Grandma never snored like this before. I must go in and see if something is wrong."
The hunter approached the bed and found a wolf lying there. He raised his rifle, ready to shoot, but then thought, "The wolf might have swallowed Grandma. Grandma might still be alive inside."
summary_zh: 狼吃饱后在床上打鼾，猎人路过听到异常的鼾声，进入屋内发现床上躺着狼，他准备开枪但想到奶奶可能还活着，于是犹豫不决。

page_text_ocr_zh:
于是，猎人找来一把剪刀，准备把狼的肚子剪开。他刚剪了两下，就看到了一顶红色的小帽子，他赶紧又剪了两下，小红帽蹦了出来，她大声喊叫：“狼肚子里黑漆漆的，真是吓死人啦！”
接着，奶奶也被救了出来。就在这时，狼醒了，他看见猎人端着枪站在床边，吓得浑身直哆嗦，他跳下床就想逃走。可是猎人怎么会放过他呢？只听见砰的一声枪响，狼被打死了。
page_text_en:
Then, the hunter found a pair of scissors and prepared to cut open the wolf's belly. He had just cut twice when he saw a small red hat. He quickly cut twice more, and Little Red Riding Hood jumped out, shouting loudly: "The wolf's belly is dark and scary, it's really terrifying!"
Next, Grandma was also rescued. At that moment, the wolf woke up. He saw the hunter standing by the bed with a gun, and was so frightened that he trembled all over. He jumped off the bed and tried to run away. But how could the hunter let him go? With a loud bang, the wolf was shot dead.
summary_zh: 猎人用剪刀剪开狼的肚子，救出了小红帽和奶奶；狼醒来后试图逃跑，被猎人开枪打死。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小红帽和奶奶得救了，狡猾的狼也被猎人打死了，大家都高兴极了。猎人剥下狼皮，回家去了。奶奶吃了小红帽带来的水果和蛋糕，精神好多了。
回家以后，小红帽对妈妈说：“妈妈，这次都怪我太贪玩了，我已经得到教训啦！以后我再也不贪玩，再也不会跟狼讲话啦！”
page_text_en:
Little Red Riding Hood and her grandmother were saved, and the cunning wolf was also killed by the hunter. Everyone was extremely happy. The hunter took off the wolf's skin and went home. Grandma ate the fruits and cake that Little Red Riding Hood had brought, and she felt much better.
After returning home, Little Red Riding Hood said to her mother, "Mom, this time it's all my fault for being too playful. I've learned my lesson! From now on, I'll never be playful again, and I'll never talk to a wolf again!"
summary_zh: 小红帽和奶奶被猎人救出，狼被杀死，大家很高兴。小红帽回家后向妈妈承认错误，表示以后不会再贪玩，也不会再跟狼说话。

page_text_ocr_zh:
过了几天，小红帽去给奶奶送水果时，又在路上碰到一只狼。
这一次，小红帽提高了警惕。她不跟狼说话，只是一个劲儿地往奶奶家跑。狼见小红帽不理他，气得嗷嗷乱叫。到了奶奶家，小红帽告诉奶奶：“奶奶，我又碰到了一只狼，那家伙嘴上说着‘你好’，可看我的眼神却凶极了。”“小红帽，他说不定会跟着你过来。我们把门关紧，不让他进来。”
page_text_en:
A few days later, Little Red Riding Hood was on her way to give fruit to her grandmother when she met a wolf again.
This time, Little Red Riding Hood was more alert. She didn't talk to the wolf and ran straight to her grandmother's house. The wolf, seeing that Little Red Riding Hood ignored him, growled angrily. When she arrived at her grandmother's house, she told her grandmother, "Grandma, I met a wolf again. He said 'hello' with his mouth, but his eyes looked very fierce." "Little Red Riding Hood, he might follow you here. Let's close the door tightly and not let him in."
summary_zh: 小红帽再次遇到狼，这次她不再与狼交谈，而是直接跑向奶奶家。她向奶奶讲述了狼的危险，奶奶提醒她要关紧门以防狼闯入。

page_text_ocr_zh:
果然，才过了一会儿，狼就来到了奶奶家门口。他恶狠狠地撞门，可是门很结实，他用尽全身力气也撞不开。
凶恶的狼可不会轻易放弃，他绕着房子走了两三圈，最后跳上了房顶。他想等到天黑，趁小红帽回家时把她吃掉。
page_text_en:
Sure enough, after a while, the wolf arrived at Grandma's doorstep. He slammed the door fiercely, but it was very sturdy, and he couldn't break it even with all his strength.
The fierce wolf wouldn't give up easily. He walked around the house two or three times, then finally jumped onto the roof. He planned to wait until dark and eat Little Red Riding Hood when she came home.
summary_zh: 狼来到奶奶家门口，撞不开门后绕着房子走，最后跳上房顶，打算等天黑时吃掉小红帽。

page_text_ocr_zh:
奶奶看穿了狼的坏心思。她想起房子前有一个大石槽，便对小红帽说：“小红帽，奶奶早上煮了香肠，你去提些煮香肠的水倒进石槽里。”小红帽听话地提了很多水，把石槽装得满满的。
香肠的气味飘进了狼的鼻孔，贪吃的狼使劲地伸长脖子闻啊闻。一不小心，狼失去了平衡，掉进石槽里淹死了。
小红帽高高兴兴地回了家。从此以后，再也没有狼敢打她的坏主意啦！
page_text_en:
Grandma saw through the wolf's evil intentions. She remembered there was a big stone trough in front of the house, and told Little Red Riding Hood, 'Little Red, Grandma cooked sausages this morning. Go fetch some of the water used to cook the sausages and pour it into the trough.' Little Red Riding Hood obediently fetched a lot of water and filled the trough to the brim.
The smell of sausages drifted into the wolf's nose. The greedy wolf stretched his neck as far as he could to sniff. Unluckily, he lost his balance and fell into the trough, drowning.
Little Red Riding Hood happily went home. From then on, no wolf dared to have any bad intentions toward her!
summary_zh: 奶奶识破狼的阴谋，让小红帽将煮香肠的水倒入石槽，狼因贪吃闻香而失足掉入石槽淹死，小红帽安全回家，从此再无狼敢害她。
画面中小红帽在绿色背景中奔跑，身边有两只蝴蝶飞舞，表现出她轻快、自由的状态。
